Longer description.

EXIT CODES
  0  success
  1  internal error (bug or I/O failure)
  2  usage error (unknown command/flag, bad argument)
  3  validation failure (input failed schema or semantic checks)
  4  missing prerequisite

Usage:
  mycli [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  hello       Greet someone
  help        Help about any command
  version     Print version, commit, build date, and runtime

Flags:
      --dry-run            where supported: full validation, no writes
  -h, --help               help for mycli
      --json               emit a machine-readable result envelope on stdout
      --log-level string   stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
      --quiet              equivalent to --log-level error

Use "mycli [command] --help" for more information about a command.
